name: db-rebuildable-projection
body: The DB stays a rebuildable projection. Correctness must never depend on a fresh `apg/.trans/db.lbug`: the next scan can rebuild it from the code, and the durable layers tree can be re-ingested into it. Mutations that do not strictly need the DB must not open it, and must not contend on it. Acceptance: a node/edge mutation path that performs its structural and code-FQN reference validation without an exclusive/read-write DB open (or that provably does not contend), plus a test showing a mutation is correct with the DB absent and the projection reconstructible by scan.
